Project Coordinator – Commercial Solar & Energy Storage

**Coldwell Solar | Rocklin, CA | Full-Time**

Big Energy. Bigger Projects. Zero Interest in Boring Work.

Some people see a set of drawings, a spreadsheet full of numbers, and a complicated electrical system.

You see an opportunity waiting to become a project.

At **Coldwell Solar**, we're looking for a **Project Coordinator** who knows that successful solar projects don't start when construction begins. They start long before the first crew arrives, with smart planning, accurate estimating, technical know-how, and someone who can connect all the moving pieces.

We're talking commercial and industrial solar installations, battery energy storage systems, equipment replacements, and repower projects. The kind of work that requires equal parts analytical thinking, construction knowledge, and the ability to keep a dozen plates spinning without dropping the important ones.

If you love figuring out how things work, what they'll cost, and what it will take to make them happen, we should talk.

Here's Where You Come In

**Crunch the Numbers. Catch the Problems.**

* Build accurate estimates, from early concepts to detailed project pricing.
* Develop material takeoffs, labor budgets, and subcontractor cost comparisons.
* Evaluate vendor proposals, identify scope gaps, and flag financial risks before they become expensive surprises.
* Keep estimating tools, templates, and historical cost information organized and up to date.

**Help Turn Opportunities Into Actual Projects.**

* Partner with Sales to evaluate commercial solar and energy storage opportunities.
* Provide technical input, preliminary pricing, and support for customer proposals.
* Participate in customer meetings and site visits to gather the information needed to evaluate potential projects.
* Review drawings, utility bills, equipment specifications, and site conditions.
* Help determine whether an opportunity makes technical and financial sense before it moves forward.

**Give Existing Solar Systems a Second Act.**

Not every solar project starts from scratch. Sometimes the smartest solution is making an existing system better.

* Take ownership of solar repower and equipment-replacement opportunities.
* Evaluate existing modules, inverters, and electrical infrastructure.
* Work with Engineering and Procurement to identify compatible equipment and practical solutions.
* Develop project scopes, budgets, schedules, and permitting and interconnection strategies.
* Move repower opportunities from evaluation through approved scope and project handoff.

**Keep the Moving Parts Moving.**

* Coordinate site evaluations, preliminary engineering, surveys, geotechnical work, and permitting feasibility.
* Track development schedules, milestones, deliverables, and outstanding decisions.
* Identify long-lead equipment and early procurement needs.
* Work with internal teams, consultants, vendors, and subcontractors to keep opportunities progressing.
* Spot potential roadblocks early and help develop solutions before they derail a project.

**Set the Construction Team Up to Win.**

Your finish line is the signed contract or limited Notice to Proceed (NTP). That's when the Project Manager and Assistant Project Manager take the reins.

* Prepare organized, accurate handoff packages with the budgets, schedules, scopes, and technical details the team needs.
* Communicate open items, assumptions, and risks clearly.
* Ensure the project team isn't left playing detective to figure out what was promised, priced, or planned.
* Help improve estimating, development, and handoff processes along the way.

What You'll Bring to the Table

**The Must-Haves:**

* 3+ years of experience in commercial solar, electrical construction, estimating, project coordination, or preconstruction.
* Working knowledge of commercial photovoltaic (PV) systems, electrical equipment, and construction practices.
* Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, single-line diagrams, and equipment specifications.
* Experience preparing estimates, budgets, and scopes of work.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to juggle multiple projects and competing priorities.
* Excellent communication skills and confidence collaborating across departments.
* Proficiency in Excel, Outlook, and Word.
* The ability to work independently, take initiative, and follow through.

**The Nice-to-Haves:**

* Commercial solar EPC and battery energy storage experience.
* Experience evaluating solar repowers and inverter replacements.
* Familiarity with California permitting, interconnection processes, and electrical codes, including PG&E and SCE requirements.
* Experience with Procore, Microsoft Project, or SharePoint.
* Background in procurement, vendor negotiations, or subcontractor coordination.

You're Probably Our Person If...

* You can look at a project and see the potential problems before anyone else notices them.
* You understand that a great estimate is more than a number on a spreadsheet.
* You enjoy the technical side of construction but also know how to communicate with actual humans.
* You don't panic when priorities shift or a project throws you a curveball.
* You're organized enough to manage the details but strategic enough to see the big picture.
* You take pride in handing off a project that's ready to go — not one held together with assumptions and crossed fingers.
* You believe problems are meant to be solved, not simply forwarded in an email.

What Does Success Look Like?

Pretty simple: Projects move forward because you did your homework.

Your estimates are accurate. Your development milestones stay on track. Your risks are identified early. Your repower opportunities are properly evaluated. And when a project transitions to construction, the PM team has what it needs to hit the ground running.

jobs.title: Manager, Independent Customer Success
jobs.description:
### **About the role:**

PetDesk is looking for a Manager, Independent Customer Success to lead the day-to-day execution of our Independent Customer Success team. The team serves clinics through two engagement models: a named CSM model for clinics that need a dedicated partner, and a pooled, digital-first model that supports clinics at scale.

The Director of Customer Success owns the frameworks and org-level strategy. This manager owns the execution layer: turning those frameworks into consistent team practice, coaching CSMs to measurable outcomes, and making sure no customer, escalation or save opportunity falls through the cracks.

Our customers are veterinary practices, not SaaS buyers, so the right approach often looks different from a traditional CS playbook. You'll help the team meet clinics where they are, whether that's a named CSM partnership or a scaled pooled experience.

### **Apply if you're excited to:**

* Manage, coach and develop a team of 7 CSMs across the named and pooled models through regular 1:1s, call and play reviews, performance feedback, goal setting and development plans
* Hire, onboard and ramp new CSMs against clear 3, 6 and 12-month outcomes, and review performance profiles at least quarterly
* Run both CS models day to day, making sure accounts sit in the right model and segment and move between models and CSMs with clean handoffs
* Balance named books equitably across CSMs based on account complexity, volume and capacity, and plan PTO coverage so response-time targets hold
* Monitor pooled queue health daily, including prioritization, response times, aging accounts and escalations, so nothing falls through the cracks
* Make sure named CSMs deliver Success Plans and Business Reviews to standard, and pooled CSMs run ChurnZero plays and one-to-many programs (webinars, virtual office hours) consistently
* Drive the Adoption milestone so new clinics graduate on time, and act on Launch CSAT, BR CSAT and NPS signals
* Own the team's churn and downgrade results, with visibility into account health and churn risk and mitigation plans built before issues escalate
* Serve as the team's escalation point, coaching CSMs through difficult customer situations and partnering with Support, Product and Implementation to resolve them
* Coach the team to identify expansion opportunities and hand qualified opportunities to Sales
* Report weekly to the Director, Customer Success on team activity, churn and downgrades, saves, loss opp pipeline, queue health, adoption and NRR
* Drive consistent use of ChurnZero and Salesforce, and keep data accurate so reporting can be trusted
* Continuously evaluate and improve plays, workflows and team practices based on customer and performance data, and surface recommendations to the Director
* Travel up to 25% for customer onsites, industry events and team gatherings

### **About you:**

* 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management or a similar customer-facing role, with 2+ years managing or formally leading a team
* Experience leading both high-touch (named book) and scaled or digital (pooled, one-to-many) Customer Success models
* Proven record of reducing churn and downgrades, running save plays, and improving retention and NRR
* Strong ability to coach to performance, set clear expectations and hold team members accountable to measurable outcomes while keeping trust high
* Experience hiring, onboarding and ramping Customer Success team members
* Analytical and data-driven, with the ability to use health scores, usage data and dashboards to prioritize team activity and spot risk early
* Highly organized and process-minded, able to manage people, priorities and volume through systems and consistent operating rhythms
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including presenting team performance and metrics to leadership
* Comfortable facilitating group settings, including webinars, virtual office hours and Business Reviews
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly with Support, Implementation, Product and Sales
* ChurnZero or comparable Customer Success platform experience required
* Salesforce or similar CRM experience required; Guru or a similar knowledge base is a plus
* Able to travel up to 25%
* Veterinary industry experience is a plus

### **What success looks like:**

* The team meets or exceeds its targets for churn, downgrades, retention and NRR. Targets are set with the Director, Customer Success and tracked as part of this role's performance goals
* Every cancellation and downgrade notice becomes a loss opp, and the team's save rate is measured against target and improves over time
* On-time Adoption milestone completion is measured against target, and every new clinic has a Success Plan
* Launch CSAT and BR CSAT are measured against target and stay at or above it
* All 7 CSMs have clear expectations and consistent coaching, meet activity and Business Review targets, and new hires ramp on schedule
* The pooled queue is consistently covered, with no aging accounts or missed response-time targets going unnoticed
* Escalations are actively managed and are resolved, routed and documented promptly
* Weekly reporting gives leadership a clear, accurate view of performance, risk and saves, backed by clean Salesforce and ChurnZero data
* Expansion opportunities are consistently identified and handed off to Sales
* Plays, workflows and team practices are regularly evaluated and improved based on performance and customer data

### **Benefits & Perks:**

* Medical coverage for employees and dependents (80-90% covered by employer)
* Employer HSA contribution with HDHP
* 401(k) match up to 3.5%
* Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Dental & Vision coverage available
* Basic Life and AD&D Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability
* Flexible Time Off & 12 Paid Annual Holidays
* Paid Parental Leave
* Pawternity Leave, Financial Pet Adoption Support & Subsidized Pet Insurance
* $250 Ann

jobs.description:
**Customer Success Lead**  
**Recycled materials**  
**Location:** Remote — Europe

**About MineHub**
=================

At MineHub, we’re transforming how the world’s largest producers, traders, and consumers manage raw material supply chains. Our solutions combine critical B2B marketplace functionality (handling high-volume transactions for global supply chains) with intuitive B2C design, enabling customers to streamline logistics, reduce costs, and build more resilient, sustainable operations through real-time data integration and predictive analytics.  
Jules extends MineHub’s offering into the recycled materials industry. Scrap and secondary-materials traders, recyclers and brokers use Jules to run their business end to end: buying and selling; managing inventory across yards and stockpiles; container, bulk, and truck logistics; trade documentation; invoicing and payments; and price-risk management.

**The Role**
============

We're looking for a Customer Success Lead to own customer success for the Jules platform. You'll combine a strong understanding of commodity supply chains with the leadership to build and develop a small, high-performing CSM team. You'll personally own our most strategic accounts while setting the standards, processes, and priorities the rest of the team works to. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll be as comfortable running a go-live with a customer's operations team as you are coaching a CSM or making the case to Product for what our customers need next. The role is highly cross-functional: you'll collaborate across CS, Product, Engineering, Sales and leadership.

**Responsibilities**
====================

* Lead, coach and develop the Jules CSM team: set clear expectations, give regular feedback, support career growth, and help hire as the team scales.
* Own the Jules customer portfolio's health, retention and expansion, and report on it to leadership with clear, commercially grounded metrics.
* Personally manage our most strategic and complex accounts, from implementation through to renewal and expansion.
* Build and continuously improve the team's playbooks: onboarding and go-live, data migration, health monitoring, QBRs, renewals and escalations.
* Act as the voice of the customer to Product and Engineering: synthesise feedback across accounts, frame it in commercial and operational terms, and influence roadmap priorities.
* Partner with Sales on pre-sales scoping, handover and expansion opportunities, ensuring what we sell can be delivered and adopted. (This is not a quota-carrying role.)
* Work with your counterparts across MineHub to share best practice and align ways of working across the group's platforms.

**Experience & Skills**
=======================

* Experience in recycled materials, metals or wider commodities trade is a strong advantage. If you're coming from an adjacent background, you'll be keen to learn how recycled materials are sourced, graded, shipped and documented, and to pick up the industry's terminology quickly.
* Experience leading, mentoring or coaching others, formally or informally: you've raised the performance of the people around you and set a standard others follow.
* Leadership qualities we'll look for at interview: sound judgement under pressure, clear prioritisation, ownership, the ability to give direct and constructive feedback, and the credibility to lead both internally and in front of customers.
* A strong track record of managing complex, multi-stakeholder accounts and software implementations, with measurable outcomes in adoption, retention or expansion.
* Strong professional English. French is a plus, as we work with a number of French-speaking customers.
* Comfortable with technical topics: data set-up, document workflows, data imports, integrations and reporting. You can get into the detail yourself and guide your team through it. SQL or BI tool experience is a plus.
* Commercially minded. You understand how our customers make money, from margins to logistics costs and price risk, and can tie platform value to their P&L.
* Process-oriented without being bureaucratic. You introduce structure that helps a small team scale, and you know when to keep things simple.
* You're a self-starter who embraces ambiguity and enjoys building something, not just running it.

**Why MineHub?**
================

* Help build the digital backbone of the circular economy, in an industry where secondary raw materials are becoming strategically critical.
* Join a mission-driven team that values integrity, collaboration, and long-term thinking in everything from customer relationships to code.
* Be part of a fast-growing company that combines startup energy with partnerships across major industry players worldwide.
* Enjoy the freedom to lead initiatives, own your accounts, and shape how recycled materials businesses experience our platform.

If you're the person who always has the checklist, chases the loose ends, and loves the feeling of getting something launched on time, this role was built for you. Join a fast-growing remote team where you’ll get to own the client experience from day one and see the impact of your work every single week.

**About Us**

Mr Med Spa helps med spa owners grow with a done-for-you patient acquisition system and consulting. That includes offer and messaging, ads and lead generation, lead nurture, and a consultative sales process that sells high ticket packages instead of discounts.

We launched in mid-2026 and grew fast. Every new client signs up expecting results quickly. The first 7 days decide whether they get them.

**The Role**

You own the first 7–10 days of every new client relationship, from the moment a deal is closed to the moment their campaigns go live.

Your job is to get every client fully set up, with every login connected and every form completed, live on time with nothing missed. Then you hand them off to their account manager ready to grow.

This is a role for someone who chases details, follows up without being asked, and can't sleep when a checklist item is still open.

* Run the access call with each new client. You'll get Meta, Google, and other platform access granted live on the call instead of waiting on emails.
* Make sure every client completes the onboarding form, the appointment setter form, and CRM connection.
* Work each new client's onboarding checklist to completion, and chase down every open item with the client and the internal team.
* Hit our go-live standard: every client live within 7 days of signup when the access call happens within 48 hours, and no later than 10 days otherwise.
* Get them their first win!

* Walk clients through our online community, onboarding trainings, and how to request support.
* Hand off each launched client to their account manager with a clean summary of where everything stands.

**What Success Looks Like**

* 90%+ of clients live within 7 days of signup
* Zero clients launched without passing test-lead QA
* No onboarding goes more than 48 hours without client contact
* Account managers receive clients with nothing missing
* New clients describe onboarding as fast and organized

Today, Thyme Care is a market-leading value-based oncology care enabler, partnering with national and regional health plans, providers, and employers to deliver better outcomes and lower costs for thousands of people across the country. jobs.title: Managed Care Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Neuronetics, together with Greenbrook Mental Wellness Centers, delivers innovative mental health treatments through FDA-cleared NeuroStar® TMS and Spravato® therapies. Our mission is to expand access to life-changing care, combining cutting-edge technology, compassionate patient support, and clinical excellence to improve lives every day. Join us in making a meaningful impact in the rapidly growing mental health field.

**Managed Care Manager**
========================

**Location:** Remote (U.S.)  
**Department:** Revenue Cycle Management  
**Reports To:** Director of Managed Care

**Help Drive Access, Reimbursement, and Growth in Healthcare**
--------------------------------------------------------------

Are you an experienced managed care professional who thrives on building payer partnerships, negotiating contracts, and improving reimbursement outcomes? We're looking for a **Managed Care Manager** to play a key role in advancing our payer strategy and supporting the continued growth of our organization.

In this role, you'll collaborate with leaders across Managed Care, Revenue Cycle, Operations, Finance, and Legal to ensure our providers and services remain accessible to patients through strong payer relationships and operational excellence. From contract negotiations and reimbursement analysis to provider enrollment and EDI operations, you'll help optimize processes that directly impact patient access and organizational success.

This is an exciting opportunity for a strategic, detail-oriented professional who enjoys solving complex challenges, driving process improvements, and influencing business outcomes in a dynamic healthcare environment.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Payer Contracting & Network Management**

* Lead and support payer contracting activities, including new agreements, renewals, amendments, network expansions, Letters of Agreement (LOAs), Single Case Agreements (SCAs), and contract maintenance.
* Negotiate reimbursement rates and evaluate fee schedules, contract language, and payer policies.
* Manage contract lifecycles, maintaining accurate records of agreements, participation requirements, and payer communications.
* Support organizational growth initiatives by facilitating payer participation for new providers, locations, and markets.

### **Reimbursement & Financial Performance**

* Analyze fee schedules, reimbursement methodologies, and payer policies to identify opportunities for improved financial performance.

* Support provider credentialing and enrollment activities, including payer affiliations, roster management, demographic updates, and participation tracking.
* Assist with EDI and payer operations such as claims, eligibility, ERA, EFT, clearinghouse enrollments, payer IDs, and troubleshooting payer connectivity issues.
* Collaborate on provider onboarding and operational implementations affecting payer participation.

### **Strategic Projects & Relationship Management**

* Serve as a key contact for payer-related issues and escalations.
* Partner with internal stakeholders on system implementations, process improvements, and managed care initiatives.
* Stay informed on Medicare, Medicaid, commercial payer, and regulatory changes, communicating key impacts and recommendations to leadership.
* Support departmental reporting, strategic planning, and special projects led by the Director of Managed Care.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, or a related field preferred.
* 3-5 years of progressive experience in managed care, payer contracting, healthcare reimbursement, or payer operations.
* Strong knowledge of commercial payers, Medicare Advantage plans, Medicaid managed care organizations (MCOs), government plans, and third-party administrators (TPAs).
* Experience negotiating contracts and managing fee schedules and reimbursement arrangements.
* Familiarity with EDI processes, ERA and EFT enrollments, and payer operational workflows.
* Working knowledge of medical coding and claims processing, including CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10.
* Strong communication, negotiation, relationship management, and analytical skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and contract management or payer-related systems.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in behavioral health, provider-based contracting, or physician practice managed care operations.
* Knowledge of value-based reimbursement models and emerging payer trends.
* Experience partnering with Finance, Revenue Cycle, and Legal teams on contract review and reimbursement matters.
* Familiarity with provider credentialing and enrollment processes.
* Proven ability to independently manage multiple projects and competing priorities.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

At our organization, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient access, provider participation, and organizational growth. You'll work alongside collaborative healthcare professionals who are passionate about improving outcomes, strengthening payer partnerships, and delivering operational excellence.

If you're ready to bring your managed care expertise to a growing organization where your work directly influences strategic success, we'd love to hear from you.

new_jobs.title: Finance and Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE LYCÉE FRANÇAIS DE SAN FRANCISCO**

The Lycée Français de San Francisco (the Lycée) is a French immersion and International College Preparatory school with 820+ students across three Bay Area campuses. The Lycée strives to maintain an international community for teachers, parents, and students of diverse social and cultural backgrounds while providing a rich educational environment that emphasizes academic excellence and personal achievement.

Our program is based on the highly recognized French national curriculum and IB Curriculum and framework enriched by key American courses, allowing flexibility and academic transfer to leading schools and universities worldwide. The Lycée is a unique environment that promotes initiative, autonomy, cooperation, and individual responsibility.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Business Office Manager is a hands-on leadership role reporting directly to the Chief Financial & Operating Officer (CFOO). This individual owns the integrity of the school’s accounting operations, leading the Business Office team, driving an accurate and on-time full-cycle close, maintaining general ledger accuracy including restricted and unrestricted fund tracking, and producing reliable financial reporting. The Manager also oversees key operational functions across the school’s three campuses, including campus security, student transportation, and insurance/risk management. This is a working-manager role: the successful candidate leads by doing, builds strong processes and controls, and raises the quality bar of the Business Office through training, documentation, and accountability.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Accounting Operations & Full-Cycle Close**

* Own the full-cycle monthly, quarterly, and year-end close, delivering an accurate close on a fixed calendar with documented checklists and review controls.
* Oversee day-to-day Business Office operations, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and the general ledger in accordance with GAAP, FASB standards, and internal policies.
* Ensure expenses are coded to the correct general ledger accounts, departments, and funds; review and approve journal entries and account classifications.
* Maintain accurate tracking, release, and reporting of restricted versus unrestricted funds in accordance with donor intent and nonprofit fund accounting standards.
* Complete monthly bank reconciliations and ensure all balance sheet accounts are reconciled and reviewed on schedule.
* Ensure vendor payments are accurate and on time; establish AP review controls that prevent late or erroneous payments.
* Manage cash flow and ensure the Lycée’s cash position is optimized.
* Lead the automation of accounts payable and other manual processes; identify and implement efficiencies across financial operations.

**Team Leadership & Training**

* Manage, coach, and develop Business Office staff across all three campuses, setting clear expectations and providing performance feedback.
* Develop and document standard operating procedures for all accounting and finance functions.
* Train Business Office staff and school employees on accounting procedures, expense policies, and financial systems.

**Financial Reporting & Analysis**

* Produce accurate and timely monthly financial reports for the CFOO, Board of Trustees, and department managers, including statements of activities and financial position by fund.
* Assist the CFOO with the presentation of accounting and financial data to the Board.
* Reconcile project cost records and support budget variance analysis.
* Support preparation of annual operating and capital budgets across multiple departments and funding sources.

**Compliance, Filings & Audit**

* File and manage local property tax returns and other required filings related to school operations across all three campuses.
* Ensure all annual, quarterly, and periodic federal, state, and local filings are completed accurately and on time, in compliance with requirements applicable to a nonprofit educational institution.
* Lead audit preparation: year-end schedules, adjusting entries, and responses to auditor inquiries.
* Implement and enforce accounting policies and internal controls; work cross-departmentally to ensure financial matters comply with Lycée policies and applicable law.

**Operations: Security, Transportation & Risk**

* Oversee campus security operations across all three campuses, including vendor/personnel management, coverage schedules, incident records, and functioning security systems (cameras, access controls, alarms).
* Oversee the student transportation program with assistance of Transportation Specialist.
* Monitor and oversee insurance needs across all campuses; liaise with brokers on coverage sufficiency and escalate risk matters to the CFOO and Head of School as appropriate.
* Take on other operational duties as the school evolves, which may include construction and building projects and other cross-functional initiatives.

**QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

**Required**

* A minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible experience in finance and accounting, including ownership of a full-cycle close.
* Strong working knowledge of GAAP, FASB standards, and nonprofit fund accounting, including restricted/unrestricted fund tracking.
* Demonstrated experience supervising, training, and developing accounting staff.
* Track record of building processes and internal controls that improve accuracy and timeliness.
* Systems thinking: capacity to see and improve interconnections between accounting, operations, and compliance workflows.
* Regulatory agility: ability to track and respond to evolving local, state, and federal compliance requirements for educational nonprofits.

**Preferred**

* CPA or equivalent, or public accounting/audit background.
* Experience with Sage Intacct accounting software, Rippling, and AI tools.
* Experience with payroll registers and journals.

Pay: $115,000.00 - $125,000.00 per year

Work Location: I

new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Global Corporate Communications (GCC) is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the data and AI systems that GCC's teams rely on. You'll build the shared foundation beneath GCC's work: making its data usable by AI, delivering the AI systems on top of it, and connecting the work across GCC and its partners.  
  
Today, a lot of GCC's most valuable data is scattered. Research, media coverage, agency reporting, processes, and planning documents live in different places and formats, with different access. That makes it hard for teams to bring it together, and hard for AI to do anything with it. You'll connect those sources, structure them so AI can actually retrieve and reason over the content, and design tools on top of them. The teams who produce the data still own it. You make sure it's structured, accessible, and fits together, so everyone gets more out of it.  
  
A lot of this job comes down to giving people across the team more ownership of their work. That happens two ways. First, by reducing dependencies, the places where people are stuck waiting on a manual step, a handoff, or the one person who knows how something works. Second, by clearing away the rote, repetitive work that fills their days. You'll get to know how GCC operates, find where both of these slow people down, and build what it takes to help. Everyone here is a builder, and your job is to support that.  
  
No two months in this role look the same. The data keeps growing, the tools keep changing, and there's always a new challenge worth taking on. It's a great fit for someone who likes to work independently, dig into complex problems, and see their work make a difference across a team.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization

**Job Title:** Farmers Market Market Manager (Program Manager I)

**Reporting To:** Farmers' Market Program Manager (Program Manager III)

**Summary**
===========

The Farmers' Market Manager works onsite to lead, set up, manage, and break-down Ecology Center's farmers' markets. In collaboration with the Program Manager and/or the Operations Manager, or alone, the Market Manager provides oversight and instruction to farmers, vendors, other market staff, and volunteers at market. The Market Manager also works in the Ecology Center office, providing operational and administrative support on non-market days. **The job involves generally working at least two market shifts per week at approximately 16 hours and 8 hours in the office each** week. Additional hours will be worked at the office, at the markets or by telecommuting based on program needs and supervisor approval. This 75% position averages around 34 hours per week.

Essential Duties

* Perform and support all duties related to operating Ecology Center Farmers' Markets in compliance with all applicable local, state and federal regulations, and in accordance with the goals and strategies of the Ecology Center mission and strategic plan.
* Manage the Ecology Center farmers' markets, serving as lead for at least one market weekly, including market set-up and breakdown, vendor parking-in, stall fee collections, signage, load list distribution and collection, info booth set-up and staffing, volunteer coordination, token distribution, and all other market activities.
* Provide on-site supervision of market staff, including Market Coordinators, regular and on- call, youth, and volunteers. Lead market operations onsite.
* Provide excellent customer service through customer interactions including token distribution, selling merchandise, and answering questions.
* Perform post-market duties including deposit preparation and financial tracking, sorting recycling/compost, cleaning soiled receptacles and/or tables, replacing and/or repairing any damaged equipment, restocking merchandise/supplies with a high degree of attention to details.
* Ensure that all market monies received are handled safely following established cash-handling procedures; oversee and assist in the preparation of market deposits within 24 hours of receipt of funds, and prepare change and tokens to be used in the following market.
* Track and report information from at-market tracking documents including market log, token distribution log, and receipt book to keep a reference of the market's activities and financials.
* Perform administrative and office duties related to the market at which Market Manager is the lead. This includes but is not limited to: following up with farmers and vendors' preparing printed materials; coordinating with local businesses, partners, neighbors and others; approving invoices; etc.
* Work with Program Manager to create agenda and attend Community Advisory Committee meetings.
* Work with the Program Manager, Operations Manager, and other Market Managers to determine vendor mix and lead market layout as seasons change.
* Assist the Program Manager in developing and implementing promotional efforts for the Farmers' Markets
* Work with Program Manager and Events Coordinator to plan, execute, and promote farmers' market events which help meet the organization and program'

goals and mission. This includes liaising with farmers' market staff, farmers and vendors to ensure successful event execution; and assisting with event set-up and logistics on event days.

* Perform general administrative duties including answering phones, responding to emails, attending meetings and events.
* Observe safe operating practices and comply with organizational safety policies including reporting incidents according to our procedures.
* Maintain familiarity with, follow, and ensure staff compliance with all Ecology Center policies and procedures in the performance of daily duties.
* Administrate the creation and publishing of relevant, original, high-quality content for social media platforms both at market and as part of office duties in accordance with our regular publishing schedule.
* Identify and improve organizational development aspects that would improve content (ie: employee training, recognition and rewards for participation in the organization's marketing and online strategies)
Lead Farmers' Markets tour initiative* -from training volunteers to contacting organizations and organizing tours year round focused on specific topics and seasons.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* The proven ability to work independently and exercise good judgment in a variety of environments and situations.
* Proven ability to manage on-site and office operations for the farmers' market or similar small business enterprise.
* Competency with word processing, spreadsheet, database in a Mac computer environment and ability and willingness to learn new applications as needed.
* Proven ability and enthusiasm for developing and maintaining relationships with participants including farmers, vendors, customers, neighbors and other members of the public
* Demonstrable ability to effectively resolve conflicts
* The ability and willingness to monitor and enforce policies with vendors and the public.
* Flexibility and creativity, ability to "think on your feet" and find appropriate solutions to unique challenges.
* Strong verbal and written communications skills.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.

Acts as the opportunity validator, ensuring required documentation and approvals — including signed MNDA, signed LOA where applicable, site lists, and invoices/spend data — are complete before an opportunity advances to the next stage.

**What is special about Lighthouse?**

Lighthouse is built on a foundation of unique, compassionate, highly driven individuals. We elevate the strengths and talents of those around us while leveraging opportunities for growth. We offer the experience of solving complex problems while continuing to grow multiple facets of your career. Lighthouse is where innovation meets support and where collaboration is the key ingredient to success. We grow together and are stronger together.

**What’s unique about this role?**

With the implementation of a formal Release Management Program, the Area Release Manager is the **area-level owner of release orchestration and readiness**. Releases within a given solution area are often highly interdependent — sharing teams, platforms, data, infrastructure, and milestones — so decisions or delays in one can impact others.

The Area Release Manager owns that **integrated, horizontal view across the area** — understanding how releases interconnect, sequencing them accordingly, managing cross-release dependencies and resource contention, and assessing the downstream impact of changes. The role drives tradeoffs, enforces readiness, guides release owners, and represents the area's overall delivery health to leadership — without owning the underlying product decisions or technical execution. Success requires strong portfolio judgment and the ability to drive sequencing, prioritization, dependency resolution, and go / no-go decisions under pressure.

**Core Responsibilities**

What will this person do?

* Own the integrated release plan and calendar for the solution area, maintaining a current view of all releases — including ownership, scope, status, key dates, dependencies, readiness, and delivery confidence.
* Provide area-level oversight across all releases, with individual releases driven by Release / Program Managers or other designated owners who roll status, risks, dependencies, and readiness into the area view.
* Orchestrate the area's release portfolio, aligning the teams and functions applicable to each release around an integrated plan, sequencing, dependencies, milestones, and readiness expectations.
* Drive release sequencing, prioritization, and tradeoffs across the area, balancing dependencies, capacity, resource constraints, business priorities, and readiness and bringing the appropriate leaders together to resolve competing commitments.
* Maintain an integrated view of capacity and resource constraints, identifying where concurrent releases create competing demands or delivery risk and driving resolution through adjustments to scope, timing, sequencing, priorities, or resources.
* Own the integrated dependency picture across the area, driving resolution of dependencies and handoffs among releases, teams, products, platforms, shared services, and other solution areas; escalate broader conflicts with impact, options, and a recommended path forward.
* Own the integrated risk and readiness picture for the area, ensuring material risks, issues, blockers, and readiness gaps are visible, actively managed, and escalated appropriately.
* Enforce defined readiness criteria and stage gates for each release, ensuring applicable requirements are met across the functions the release impacts and surfacing gaps early for resolution.
* Hold the area-level go / no-go decision, based on defined readiness criteria and an integrated assessment of readiness across the applicable functions; escalate unresolved readiness concerns or cross-area impacts as needed.
* Oversee execution of the release management framework within the area, ensuring defined processes, lifecycle stages, gates, governance, and ways of working are consistently applied; identify and drive resolution of process issues, ownership or handoff gaps, and breakdowns across the release lifecycle and impacted pillars.
* Guide and coordinate Release / Program Managers and other release owners across the area, reinforcing expectations for planning, reporting, risk management, readiness, governance, work-tracking discipline, and delivery quality.
* Provide a trusted, integrated view of area release health to leadership and the enterprise release process, including releases, milestones, dependencies, capacity constraints, risks, readiness, and delivery confidence; ensure accurate, timely information is maintained in the designated system of record.

**Bring your passion and together we will shine. It would also be great if you had the following:**

* Extensive experience in program or release management, technical program management, or delivery leadership, including ownership of a portfolio or program area.
* Proven ability to sequence and manage multiple interdependent releases or programs across teams and functions.
* Strong prioritization and decision judgment; comfortable owning sequencing and go / no-go calls under pressure.
* Excellent orchestration, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills; drives alignment and decisions without direct authority.
* Command of enterprise release management practice — stage gates, release calendars, CAB, dependency mapping, DORA-style metrics; comfortable across Product, Engineering, and partner functions.

**Work Environment and Physical Demands**

* Duties are performed in a typical office environment while at a desk or computer table.
* Duties require the ability to use a computer, communicate over the telephone, and read printed material, in a quiet and professional setting.
* Duties may require being on call periodically and working outside normal working hours (evenings and weekends).

**Coldwell Solar | Rocklin, CA | Full-Time**

Big Energy. Bigger Projects. Zero Interest in Boring Work.

Some people see a set of drawings, a spreadsheet full of numbers, and a complicated electrical system.

At **Coldwell Solar**, we're looking for a **Project Coordinator** who knows that successful solar projects don't start when construction begins. They start long before the first crew arrives, with smart planning, accurate estimating, technical know-how, and someone who can connect all the moving pieces.

We're talking commercial and industrial solar installations, battery energy storage systems, equipment replacements, and repower projects. The kind of work that requires equal parts analytical thinking, construction knowledge, and the ability to keep a dozen plates spinning without dropping the important ones.

If you love figuring out how things work, what they'll cost, and what it will take to make them happen, we should talk.

Here's Where You Come In

**Crunch the Numbers. Catch the Problems.**

* Build accurate estimates, from early concepts to detailed project pricing.
* Develop material takeoffs, labor budgets, and subcontractor cost comparisons.
* Evaluate vendor proposals, identify scope gaps, and flag financial risks before they become expensive surprises.

* Partner with Sales to evaluate commercial solar and energy storage opportunities.

* Review drawings, utility bills, equipment specifications, and site conditions.

Not every solar project starts from scratch. Sometimes the smartest solution is making an existing system better.

* Evaluate existing modules, inverters, and electrical infrastructure.
* Work with Engineering and Procurement to identify compatible equipment and practical solutions.
* Develop project scopes, budgets, schedules, and permitting and interconnection strategies.
* Move repower opportunities from evaluation through approved scope and project handoff.

**Keep the Moving Parts Moving.**

Your finish line is the signed contract or limited Notice to Proceed (NTP). That's when the Project Manager and Assistant Project Manager take the reins.

* Prepare organized, accurate handoff packages with the budgets, schedules, scopes, and technical details the team needs.
* Communicate open items, assumptions, and risks clearly.
* Ensure the project team isn't left playing detective to figure out what was promised, priced, or planned.
* Help improve estimating, development, and handoff processes along the way.

**The Must-Haves:**

* 3+ years of experience in commercial solar, electrical construction, estimating, project coordination, or preconstruction.

* Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, single-line diagrams, and equipment specifications.

* Strong organizational skills and the ability to juggle multiple projects and competing priorities.
* Excellent communication skills and confidence collaborating across departments.
* Proficiency in Excel, Outlook, and Word.
* The ability to work independently, take initiative, and follow through.

**The Nice-to-Haves:**

* Commercial solar EPC and battery energy storage experience.
* Experience evaluating solar repowers and inverter replacements.
* Familiarity with California permitting, interconnection processes, and electrical codes, including PG&E and SCE requirements.
* Experience with Procore, Microsoft Project, or SharePoint.
* Background in procurement, vendor negotiations, or subcontractor coordination.

You're Probably Our Person If...

* You can look at a project and see the potential problems before anyone else notices them.
* You understand that a great estimate is more than a number on a spreadsheet.
* You enjoy the technical side of construction but also know how to communicate with actual humans.
* You don't panic when priorities shift or a project throws you a curveball.
* You're organized enough to manage the details but strategic enough to see the big picture.
* You take pride in handing off a project that's ready to go — not one held together with assumptions and crossed fingers.
* You believe problems are meant to be solved, not simply forwarded in an email.

new_jobs.description:
### **About the role:**

PetDesk is looking for a Manager, Independent Customer Success to lead the day-to-day execution of our Independent Customer Success team. The team serves clinics through two engagement models: a named CSM model for clinics that need a dedicated partner, and a pooled, digital-first model that supports clinics at scale.

The Director of Customer Success owns the frameworks and org-level strategy. This manager owns the execution layer: turning those frameworks into consistent team practice, coaching CSMs to measurable outcomes, and making sure no customer, escalation or save opportunity falls through the cracks.

Our customers are veterinary practices, not SaaS buyers, so the right approach often looks different from a traditional CS playbook. You'll help the team meet clinics where they are, whether that's a named CSM partnership or a scaled pooled experience.

### **Apply if you're excited to:**

* Manage, coach and develop a team of 7 CSMs across the named and pooled models through regular 1:1s, call and play reviews, performance feedback, goal setting and development plans
* Hire, onboard and ramp new CSMs against clear 3, 6 and 12-month outcomes, and review performance profiles at least quarterly
* Run both CS models day to day, making sure accounts sit in the right model and segment and move between models and CSMs with clean handoffs
* Balance named books equitably across CSMs based on account complexity, volume and capacity, and plan PTO coverage so response-time targets hold
* Monitor pooled queue health daily, including prioritization, response times, aging accounts and escalations, so nothing falls through the cracks
* Make sure named CSMs deliver Success Plans and Business Reviews to standard, and pooled CSMs run ChurnZero plays and one-to-many programs (webinars, virtual office hours) consistently
* Drive the Adoption milestone so new clinics graduate on time, and act on Launch CSAT, BR CSAT and NPS signals
* Own the team's churn and downgrade results, with visibility into account health and churn risk and mitigation plans built before issues escalate
* Serve as the team's escalation point, coaching CSMs through difficult customer situations and partnering with Support, Product and Implementation to resolve them
* Coach the team to identify expansion opportunities and hand qualified opportunities to Sales
* Report weekly to the Director, Customer Success on team activity, churn and downgrades, saves, loss opp pipeline, queue health, adoption and NRR
* Drive consistent use of ChurnZero and Salesforce, and keep data accurate so reporting can be trusted
* Continuously evaluate and improve plays, workflows and team practices based on customer and performance data, and surface recommendations to the Director
* Travel up to 25% for customer onsites, industry events and team gatherings

### **About you:**

* 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management or a similar customer-facing role, with 2+ years managing or formally leading a team
* Experience leading both high-touch (named book) and scaled or digital (pooled, one-to-many) Customer Success models
* Proven record of reducing churn and downgrades, running save plays, and improving retention and NRR
* Strong ability to coach to performance, set clear expectations and hold team members accountable to measurable outcomes while keeping trust high
* Experience hiring, onboarding and ramping Customer Success team members
* Analytical and data-driven, with the ability to use health scores, usage data and dashboards to prioritize team activity and spot risk early
* Highly organized and process-minded, able to manage people, priorities and volume through systems and consistent operating rhythms
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including presenting team performance and metrics to leadership
* Comfortable facilitating group settings, including webinars, virtual office hours and Business Reviews
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly with Support, Implementation, Product and Sales
* ChurnZero or comparable Customer Success platform experience required
* Salesforce or similar CRM experience required; Guru or a similar knowledge base is a plus
* Able to travel up to 25%
* Veterinary industry experience is a plus

### **What success looks like:**

* The team meets or exceeds its targets for churn, downgrades, retention and NRR. Targets are set with the Director, Customer Success and tracked as part of this role's performance goals
* Every cancellation and downgrade notice becomes a loss opp, and the team's save rate is measured against target and improves over time
* On-time Adoption milestone completion is measured against target, and every new clinic has a Success Plan
* Launch CSAT and BR CSAT are measured against target and stay at or above it
* All 7 CSMs have clear expectations and consistent coaching, meet activity and Business Review targets, and new hires ramp on schedule
* The pooled queue is consistently covered, with no aging accounts or missed response-time targets going unnoticed
* Escalations are actively managed and are resolved, routed and documented promptly
* Weekly reporting gives leadership a clear, accurate view of performance, risk and saves, backed by clean Salesforce and ChurnZero data
* Expansion opportunities are consistently identified and handed off to Sales
* Plays, workflows and team practices are regularly evaluated and improved based on performance and customer data

### **Benefits & Perks:**

* Medical coverage for employees and dependents (80-90% covered by employer)
* Employer HSA contribution with HDHP
* 401(k) match up to 3.5%
* Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Dental & Vision coverage available
* Basic Life and AD&D Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability
* Flexible Time Off & 12 Paid Annual Holidays
* Paid Parental Leave
* Pawternity Leave, Financial Pet Adoption Support & Subsidized Pet Insurance
* $250 Ann

**About Us**

Mr Med Spa helps med spa owners grow with a done-for-you patient acquisition system and consulting. That includes offer and messaging, ads and lead generation, lead nurture, and a consultative sales process that sells high ticket packages instead of discounts.

We launched in mid-2026 and grew fast. Every new client signs up expecting results quickly. The first 7 days decide whether they get them.

**The Role**

You own the first 7–10 days of every new client relationship, from the moment a deal is closed to the moment their campaigns go live.

Your job is to get every client fully set up, with every login connected and every form completed, live on time with nothing missed. Then you hand them off to their account manager ready to grow.

* 90%+ of clients live within 7 days of signup

* New clients describe onboarding as fast and organized

Apply directly here on indeed and we will be in touch with a short application.

**Compliance**
--------------

* Ensure client practices comply with federal, California, and other applicable state and local employment laws, including FLSA, FMLA, CFRA, ADA, FEHA, Title VII, and Cal/OSHA.
* Track multi-state requirements for clients with employees outside California.
* Draft, review, and update employee handbooks, policies, and procedures.
* Advise on wage and hour issues, including exempt versus non-exempt classification, meal and rest breaks, and overtime.
* Coordinate required training, such as California harassment prevention training.
* Manage required postings, notices, and filings, including EEO-1 reporting where applicable.
* Support leave administration, including FMLA, CFRA, pregnancy disability, and paid sick leave.
* Coordinate workplace accommodation requests through the interactive process.
* Conduct HR audits and recommend corrective actions to reduce risk.

**Payroll and Benefits**
------------------------

* Process or review semi-monthly and bi-weekly payroll for multiple clients through platforms such as Paychex, Gusto, GoCo, Rippling, and Paycom.
* Verify timekeeping, PTO accruals, deductions, and pay changes for accuracy.
* Resolve payroll discrepancies and respond to employee pay questions.
* Support benefits administration, including open enrollment, new hire enrollment, COBRA, and life event changes.
* Coordinate with benefits brokers, payroll vendors, and client finance teams.
* Support compensation reviews and salary benchmarking for nonprofit roles.

**HR Operations and Other HR Tasks**
------------------------------------

* Maintain accurate, confidential personnel files and HRIS records.
* Prepare HR reports on headcount, turnover, and other metrics.
* Create HR templates, forms, and process guides for client use.
* Support organizational changes, including restructuring, layoffs, and mergers.
* Assist with training and development programs for client staff and managers.
* Support employee engagement surveys and recognition initiatives.
* Assist with workers’ compensation claims and unemployment responses.
* Perform other HR duties as assigned to meet client needs.
